description: Purge cached content. With resource_id: purge that aCDN resource — everything (clear_all=true) or specific URLs. Without resource_id: purge by full URLs across all resources (the zone is matched by domain automatically).

clear_all.description: Purge the entire cache of the resource (requires resource_id)

resource_id.description: aCDN resource (pull zone) ID. Omit to purge by URL across all resources.

urls.description: URLs/paths to purge. Required unless clear_all is true.

name: purge_cache
title: Purge CDN cache
